subject: CloudStack webinar — routing plan, replay link & SDR orchestration
messages:
From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.ai>
Cc: 
Date: 2026-11-19T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: CloudStack webinar — attendee list + routing proposal

Team — quick post-session package from this morning's CloudStack webinar. Overall turnout was solid (410 registered; 218 attended). I exported the attendee CSV and a first-pass MQL routing sheet — attach below.

Key asks:
- Can SDRs claim any account in the HOT bucket within 24 hours? HOT = attended, job title = Dev/Platform/Infra lead or VP, company size > 500.
- Assign warm/outbound pockets to regional reps for nurture cadence (see sheet).
- Need the replay link shared to attendees within 6 hours; external asked for an ops copy as well.

Files attached: attendee_export_20261119.csv (export of attendees), mql_routing_v1.xlsx (proposed buckets + assignment).

Proposed timeline:
1) 6h: send replay to all attendees (auto email + replay_share_link.txt)
2) 24h: SDRs follow up HOT with proposed demo windows
3) 3 business days: nurture cadence for WARM pool (3-touch email + call)

Notes: CloudStack asked that any pilot/SLA discussion be routed to enterprise_sales@cloudstack within the first demo — flag to me if that happens.

Thanks —
Priya Natarajan
Field Marketing Manager, Redwood Inference
(attachment: attendee_export_20261119.csv - csv)
(attachment: mql_routing_v1.xlsx - xlsx)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-19T10:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: CloudStack webinar — attendee list + routing proposal

Priya — thanks for the quick package, good breakdown. A few clarifications from SDR ops so we can hand off cleanly: 

1) HOT bucket sizing looks like ~42 accounts (see tab "HOT-count"). I recommend splitting by existing ownership first — if no owner, route to regional pool: West (Ben), East (Logan), EMEA (Marissa).

2) For HOT follow-up script: 1) quick thank you + replay, 2) 1-click demo scheduler (Calendly link), 3) ask about current inference infra and pain w/ latency/cost. I'll add the script to the sheet.

3) SLA for demo requests: agree 24-hour SLA for HOT leads. I'll add a column to mql_routing_v1.xlsx for "claimed_by" and "claim_deadline". If unclaimed at 24h, I will auto-assign to West pool.

Also — can we confirm the replay destination? Priya, you mentioned an ops copy. If we share via Drive, please add a short tracking param for link clicks.

Marissa
Sr. SDR Ops Manager
(quoting original)

Thanks Priya/Marissa/Stephanie — the team here appreciated the session. A couple quick asks from our side: 

1) Could you send a condensed CSV with only attendees that listed "Platform" or "SRE" in title? We want to share with our product folks.
2) Please prioritize follow-up for these accounts: BrightLayer Inc., Kestrel Systems, and BlueRiver Labs — they flagged interest in pilots during Q&A. If possible, can an SDR reach out with a pilot-ops intro?

Also — we'll take the replay link. Can someone schedule a short 30-min intro/demo next week? I'll drop a few time windows if you want me to coordinate.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — Julie Park, Events & Partnerships, CloudStack
